card.name: Small words after dose amounts
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as at, over, of, once or each right after a dose, frequency or count. Typical setting is dosing text like 'once daily at bedtime' or 'per day over baseline'.

modes.label: At bedtime
modes.description: The word 'at' after 'once daily' leading into bedtime timing.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The recommended dosage is 50 mg administered orally once daily<< at>> bedtime. ( 2.1 )

modes.label: Over a period or baseline
modes.description: The word 'over' after a count of doses or stools, before a duration or baseline.
modes.example: If significant clinical toxicity is observed, leucovorin rescue should be extended for an additional 24 hours (total of 14 doses<< over>> 84 hours) in subsequent courses

modes.label: Other linking words after amounts
modes.description: Words like 'of', 'once' or 'each' placed right after a dose or percentage.
modes.example: 75 mg per day<< of>> another venlafaxine extended-release

card.plain: It fires on the small word right after a dose amount, often just before 'bedtime' or a time span.
